content.text: The URL in confirmNewEmail points to /confirm-email; it should be /confirm-new-email. I'll check the controller route quickly.

candidates.explanation: The confirmation link for a changed email is built with the frontend path '/confirm-email'. That is the same page the sign-up activation mail (userSignUp) links to. The frontend page posts the hash to the sign-up endpoint (auth/email/confirm → AuthService.confirmEmail). The new-email hash is never sent to auth/email/confirm/new (AuthService.confirmNewEmail), so the email change is never completed. The path should be '/confirm-new-email'.

fix.description: In MailService.confirmNewEmail, change the URL path from '/confirm-email' to '/confirm-new-email' so the frontend page calls POST auth/email/confirm/new.
